text: 你脱口向陌生人打招呼，试图让他感到受欢迎。他的脸扭曲成失望的神情，随后转过身去。你显然不知怎么惹恼了他，他不想再理你。

en.title: Alone Against the Tide · 37
text: You blurt out a greeting, trying to make the stranger feel welcome. His face contorts into a look of disappointment, and the man turns his back on you. You have clearly displeased him somehow, and he wants nothing more to do with you.
